title: stella radiata
intro: Stella radiata, commonly known as the Moonseed plant or Menispermum canadense, is a perennial climber native to eastern North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits such as treating rheumatism, fever, and as a laxative. The therapeutic actions of Stella radiata include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in relieving pain and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of Stella radiata include lignans, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
